APWorld-0.1.0.description:
Based on APQuest 8ca584be93d6707ebd35773cb85dc3e76aeb27e9

**First release of the Forge Adventure mode APWorld project.**
The project supports forge-archipelago which can be found [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/tree/dev_archipelago).

**Make sure to read `ARCHIPELAGO.md` for instructions on how to use & set up the Archipelago mode [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/blob/dev_archipelago/ARCHIPELAGO.md).**

Check out the [requirements doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1z1r4p_NAsm1oOKPqkfo45QEBCeYHCi71h6-LmySQdt4/edit?usp=sharing) for our progress.
APWorld-0.1.0.title: Forge APWorld v0.1.0

APWorld-0.1.1.description:
Based on APQuest 8ca584be93d6707ebd35773cb85dc3e76aeb27e9

**Hotfix for Forge Adventure mode APWorld project.**
The project supports forge-archipelago which can be found [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/tree/dev_archipelago).

**Make sure to read `ARCHIPELAGO.md` for instructions on how to use & set up the Archipelago mode [here](https://github.com/BramTeurlings/forge-archipelago/blob/dev_archipelago/ARCHIPELAGO.md).**

Check out the [requirements doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1z1r4p_NAsm1oOKPqkfo45QEBCeYHCi71h6-LmySQdt4/edit?usp=sharing) for our progress.

### Changelog
- Fixed a bug where an increase of total cards collected locations would lead to the equipment shops no longer populating and "unknown locations" appearing in the AP client console.
- Removed unnecessary boss locations.
APWorld-0.1.1.title: Forge APWorld v0.1.1
